text:
Implemented:
- `VersionInfo.to_tuple()` returning all five version parts.
- `VersionInfo.to_dict()` returning a new dictionary of those parts.
- Integer indexing, negative indexing, and slicing via `__getitem__`.

Preserved existing private accessors and added `STATUS.json`.

Validation: all 195 existing tests passed, plus direct checks for accessors and indexing edge cases.
